player_behavior: If a draft cancellation request cannot reach the local runtime, desktop and Android stop waiting locally, invalidate the request identity and ignore any late draft response; no World, Run or archive is created.

If a turn cancellation request cannot reach the local runtime, Android keeps the operation visible and explains that the current journey is still processing instead of pretending the turn was cancelled.
A subsequently completed turn still updates the same Run after a failed cancellation request, preserving the original state transition boundary.
not_proven: Actual Android transport failure and cancellation during a physical-device model request remain unrun because adb devices is empty.
Windows native package and macOS packaged WebView recovery remain unrun.
